deficiencies.description: The source phrasing 'or there's some reason if you're showing symptoms' is unclear and incomplete. The rewrite makes it clear by interpreting symptoms as an example ('such as') of 'some other reason', thereby selecting one reading over other possible interpretations.

deficiencies.description: The source sentence is syntactically incomplete/broken ('many of the people that do go for screening and then for further treatment, it has a very, very high false positive rate', where 'it' refers to breast screening). The rewrite completes this unclear statement by asserting that the people who go for screening and further treatment 'are affected by a very high false positive rate', choosing a specific resolution for an incomplete statement and obscuring that the false positive rate is an attribute of the screening test.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: because many of the people that do go for screening and then for further treatment, it has a very, very high false positive rate.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: because many of the people who go for screening and then for further treatment are affected by a very high false positive rate.

deficiencies.description: The text states a causal/consequential link ('so a very, very high cost'), indicating that unnecessary treatment results in a very high cost. The rewrite changes this to an equative link ('which is a very high cost'), equating the treatment itself with the cost.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: so a very, very high cost.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: which is a very high cost.
